title: Thai-Italian Chicken Skewers with Glazed Oranges
description: A fusion of Italian and Thai flavors with juicy chicken skewers served with a sweet and sticky glazed orange sauce.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

ingredients.name: glazed
ingredients.notes: honey or maple syrup for glaze

ingredients.name: northern thai chili
ingredients.notes: or substitute with red pepper flakes

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together glaze ingredients. Set aside.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush chicken with oil and season with salt, pepper, and Thai chili.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While skewers are cooking, reduce glaze over low heat until thickened.
Serve skewers hot with a drizzle of glaze and a slice of orange on the side.
